content: Sebɛa n lmalakat s sebɛa n ṭṭawyat
Uca sřiɣ ict n tmijja zi Zzawect Tameqqrant tᵉttřaɣa x sebɛa n lmalakat nni, tenna:
“Uyurent, ttfarrɣent sebɛa n ṭṭawyat n weɣḍab n AREBBI x temmurt!”
Wenni d amezwaru yuyur, ifarreɣ ṭṭawya nnes x temmurt. Uca idweř ijj n ubuɛrus d aɛeffan iqbeḥ ɣar iwdan i ɣar teǧa řmarka n řweḥc, inni isejden i řexyař nnes.
Xenni ifarreɣ lmalak wiss tnayen ṭṭawya nnes di řebḥar uca idweř řebḥar am idammen n ijj n umettin, uca kuř řeɛmar iddaren di řebḥar immut.
Xenni ifarreɣ lmalak wiss třata ṭṭawya nnes x iɣezran d tařawin, uca aman nsen dewřen d idammen.
Uca sřiɣ i lmalak n waman iqqar:
“Cek d amseggad, Cek d wenni iǧan d wenni tuɣa, d wenni d amezdag qaɛ, umi tkemmřed řeḥkamat-a ammu.
Minzi nitni ssizzřen idammen n inabiyyen d imqeddasen, tewcid asen ɛawed ad swen idammen, maɣar ammu i d asen dd-iffeɣ.”
Uca sřiɣ aqa aɛalṭar iqqar:
“Wah, a SIDI AREBBI, Amzemmar x kuřci, řeḥkamat nnec d tidett d tasegda.”
Xenni ifarreɣ lmalak wiss arebɛa ṭṭawya nnes x tfuct uca temmewc as i tfuct, ḥima ad tecnef iwdan s tmessi.
Uca cemḍen iwdan s řɛabuq imɣaren n tmessi uca ceqqfen deg Yisem n AREBBI wenni ɣar teǧa ṣṣulṭa x jjrayeḥ-a uca war tuben ca maḥend ad as wcin aɛuǧi.
Xenni ifarreɣ lmalak wiss xemsa ṭawya nnes x řɛarc n řweḥc uca tewḍa-dd taǧest x tgeldit n řweḥc. Uca zeɛfen deg iřes nsen s ssibbet n řeḥriq
uca ceqqfen deg Yisem n AREBBI n ijenwan s ssibbet n řeḥriq d ibuɛrusen nsen, maca war tuben ca zi řexdayem nsen.
Xenni ifarreɣ lmalak wiss setta ṭṭawya nnes deg iɣzar ameqqran, iɣzar n Lfuraṭ uca uẓɣen waman nnes, ařami issewjed abrid i ijeǧiden inni dd ɣa yasen zi manis dd-tneqqar tfuct.
Xenni ẓriɣ, aqa třata n řaryaḥ imengas am iqarqriwen ffɣen-dd zeg uxenfuc n řhaycet u zeg uqemmum n řweḥc u zeg uqemmum n unabi issxarriqen,
maɣar nitni d řaryaḥ n ccwaṭen inni itteggen řeɛřamat i d igguren ɣar ijeǧiden n ddunect, maḥend ad ten ssmunen i umenɣi deg wass ameqqran n AREBBI, Amzemmar x kuřci.
“Xzar, Necc ad dd-aseɣ am yijj n uceffar! Sseɛd n wenni i ɣa iqqimen ifaq, wenni i ɣa iḥḍan arruḍ nnes ḥima war iggur d aɛaryan, war ittwaẓar useḍḥi nnes.”
Uca issmun i-ten ɣar wemcan umi ttřaɣan s Tɛibranit ‘Megiddu’.
Xenni ifarreɣ lmalak wiss sebɛa ṭṭawya nnes x řeɛwin uca tusa-dd ict n tmijja tejhed zi Zzawect Tameqqrant, zi zzat n řɛarc, teqqar:
“Aqa ittwakemmeř!”
Uca usin-dd wassamen d wajjajen, uca imsar ijj n wenhezzi n temmurt d ameqqran, war temsar ammu zeg wami iǧa bnadem di temmurt, ammu i imɣar.
Tandint tameqqrant tewḍa tebḍa x třata n tseqqar uca marra tineddam n řegnus hedment uca AREBBI iɛqeř x tendint tameqqrant Babil, ḥima ad as iwc řkas n binu n tefqeḥt n weɣḍab nnes.
Uca kuř tagzirt tarweř, war ttwifin ca idurar ɛad,
wḍan-dd ibquqen imeqqranen n tebruri zeg ujenna x iwdan, tuɣa ddqeř nsen anect n ict n ‘talint’, uca iwdan ceqqfen di AREBBI zi ssibbet n jjriḥect n tebruri, minzi jjriḥect nnes tuɣa temɣar aṭṭas.
